hypothesis_text: Matter-sensitive descriptors separate cases beyond mass-only ordering under predeclared diagnostics.
primary_endpoint: matter_sensitive_status versus mass_only_status under fixed diagnostics
required_control: mass-only control; shuffled matter descriptors; fixed tau reporting; declared random seed if stochastic components exist
success_condition: Matter-sensitive diagnostics remain stronger than mass-only diagnostics under the predeclared endpoint and controls.
failure_condition: Mass-only ordering reproduces the observed structure, or shuffled matter descriptors close the control gap.
claim_safe_interpretation: A successful rerun supports a candidate matter-sensitive marker/modifier axis under tested controls, not an established physical RMS carrier.
warning_mode: score engineering, tau post-selection, descriptor leakage, or mass-only dominance

hypothesis_text: Isotope changes produce controlled signature shifts without chemical-identity or carrier overclaiming.
required_control: mass-matched controls; isotope-label shuffle; descriptor shuffle; separate reporting for general, carbon, and strontium isotope families
success_condition: Isotope-specific shifts remain visible under mass-matched and label-shuffled controls in at least the primary general isotope rerun.
failure_condition: Isotope shifts disappear under mass matching, are reproduced by label shuffles, or depend on a single post hoc isotope family.
claim_safe_interpretation: A successful rerun supports isotope-sensitive surrogate marker behavior, not physical validation and not a proof of RMS carrier status.
warning_mode: mass leakage, label leakage, isotope family overfitting, or chemical identity overclaiming

hypothesis_text: VDW descriptors add information beyond wave-only ordering and do not reduce to score mixing or normalization artifacts.
primary_endpoint: VDW incremental information beyond wave-only under predeclared weight and normalization sweeps
required_control: wave-only; VDW-only; combined; weight sweep; permuted VDW parameters; mass/lambda-matched species controls; normalization sensitivity; tau-window readout
success_condition: Combined or VDW-sensitive readouts show a stable, predeclared incremental gap over wave-only controls that survives VDW permutation and normalization checks.
failure_condition: VDW advantage vanishes under permutation, depends on weight/normalization tuning, or is reproduced by wave-only or mass/lambda-matched controls.
claim_safe_interpretation: A successful rerun supports a candidate matter-sensitive VDW marker/modifier axis, not VDW carrier establishment.
warning_mode: score mixing, normalization artifact, off-window tau response, or post hoc weight selection

hypothesis_text: negative/abs remain jointly stronger than positive under current controls.
primary_endpoint: shared negative/abs upper block versus positive under predeclared channel diagnostics
required_control: negative/abs/positive channel comparison; fixed theta/tau where applicable; channel-label controls; dataset-level reporting
success_condition: negative and/or abs channels remain jointly separated from positive across the predeclared model and marker diagnostics.
failure_condition: positive reproduces the upper-block behavior, channel-label controls close the gap, or separation depends on a post hoc endpoint.
claim_safe_interpretation: A successful rerun supports a shared negative/abs marker block under tested controls, not a physical carrier claim.
warning_mode: channel overinterpretation, label leakage, or treating marker behavior as carrier proof

hypothesis_text: negative does not become privileged unless it separates robustly from abs under predeclared tests.
required_control: fixed negative-vs-abs metrics; marker-level and model-level comparison; dataset-level controls; channel-label swap
success_condition: negative separates from abs consistently across predeclared model and marker endpoints and survives channel-label controls.
failure_condition: negative and abs remain indistinguishable, separation flips by dataset, or marker/model tests disagree without explanation.
claim_safe_interpretation: Until success conditions are met, the correct phrase remains shared negative/abs upper block, not negative channel carrier.
warning_mode: overprivileging negative despite inconclusive negative-vs-abs separation

hypothesis_text: Matter Signature axes are modifiers or marker layers unless connected to RMS carrier stability and Geometry Anchor conditions.
primary_endpoint: marker/modifier status remains separated from carrier status unless stability, specificity, and geometry-anchor requirements are met
required_control: PADS-01 separation where applicable; Geometry Anchor checks where distance interpretation is used; marker-vs-carrier status table; anti-mimicry controls
success_condition: Matter Signature axes remain useful as markers/modifiers while no axis is promoted to carrier without satisfying the RMS Carrier/Stability Criteria and Geometry Anchor Conditions.
failure_condition: A marker/readout is promoted to carrier status based only on archival support, score strength, or descriptor performance.
claim_safe_interpretation: This is a governance hypothesis: it preserves claim discipline and prevents marker-to-carrier upgrades.
warning_mode: post hoc carrier selection, D_rel-as-carrier confusion, VDW carrier overclaim, or Carbon calibration overread
